lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The median row exhibits approximately 9 primary centroids between the gills and the anterior base of the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side of the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple low-luminance elongated shapes (commensal organisms) attached to the ventral-lateral region near the pectoral fin and mid-body.
